stories.headline: At least 58 states and territories contaminated by landmines, UN human rights chief says At least 945 people were killed and 4,325 injured by landmines and explosive remnants of war in 2024 alone, the UN said, citing the Landmine and Cluster Munitio
stories.summary: At least 58 states and territories are contaminated by landmines, according to the UN human rights chief. In 2024, landmines and explosive remnants of war caused 945 deaths and 4,325 injuries. The contamination affects various regions, with heavy civilian casualties reported in Myanmar. Seven countries, including Afghanistan, remain heavily contaminated. The UN cited the Landmine and Cluster Munition Monitor in reporting the casualties. The contamination poses a significant threat to civilians, with thousands affected each year. The numbers highlight the ongoing issue of landmine contamination and its devastating impact on communities worldwide. The UN continues to address the problem, with efforts to clear contaminated areas and support affected populations.

stories.headline: Trump: Israel's war on Hezbollah is too long, too deadly; Syria should fight the group instead 'Without me, there'd be no Israel,' president claims at G7 summit; threatens 'ultimate consequences' if Iran seeks nukes; MOU to be signed Friday in Swiss mount
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump criticized Israel's conduct in its fight against Hezbollah, stating that the conflict has gone on for too long and too many noncombatants have been killed. He suggested that Syria should take over the fight against the Iran-backed group in Lebanon, saying "If Israel can't do the job without killing everyone else, Syria will do the job." Trump made these comments at the G7 Summit in Evian, France, where he also claimed that "without the United States, there would be no Israel." He expressed disapproval of Israel's attack on the Lebanese capital of Beirut and threatened "ultimate consequences" if Iran seeks nuclear weapons. A Memorandum of Understanding is set to be signed on Friday in the Swiss mountains, amid ongoing tensions in the region. Trump's remarks were made alongside the Emir of Qatar.

stories.headline: If Zelenskyy is 'ready to speak'....: Russia on settling Ukraine war The Kremlin on Tuesday said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy could travel to Moscow for talks if he is prepared for 'responsible and serious' discussions
stories.summary: The Kremlin has stated that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy can travel to Moscow for talks if he is prepared for "responsible and serious" discussions to resolve the Ukraine conflict. However, Zelenskyy believes Russian President Putin is the obstacle to peace talks. The Ukrainian leader is currently attending the G7 summit, where he is pushing for more air defense support and increased pressure on Russia. US President has met with Zelenskyy and will meet with him again, confirming their earlier meeting was "very good". The US President emphasized that Russia should make a deal to end the conflict. The situation remains stalled, with ceasefire talks ongoing but no breakthrough in sight. Zelenskyy's visit to Moscow is conditional on his willingness to engage in meaningful discussions, as stated by the Kremlin.

stories.headline: What is in Donald Trump's Iran deal and what does Tehran hope to gain? Iran agreeing to a ceasefire deal with the United States tells us Tehran likely had something to gain from signing on. This is what Iran is promoting as the 14-
stories.summary: Iran and the US announced a temporary two-week ceasefire on April 7, 2026, and are nearing a broader peace agreement. The deal includes a permanent and immediate cessation of hostilities, and Iran hopes to gain guarantees that the US will stick to the agreement, potentially endorsed by a UN Security Council resolution. The US aims to curb Iran's nuclear program and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iran wants to retain its uranium enrichment capabilities. The deal may also address Tehran's ballistic missile program and support for proxy groups. The agreement has led to a surge in stock indexes and a drop in oil futures, with investors anticipating easing geopolitical tensions. The final agreement is expected to be endorsed by the UN Security Council after 60 days. Iranian officials will continue negotiating with the US to finalize the terms.

stories.headline: [NBC News] Apple AirPods Pro 3 You can grab Apple AirPods Pro 3 for less than $200 on Amazon right now. They’re our favorite wireless earbuds for anyone with an iPhone.
stories.summary: Apple AirPods Pro 3 are available on Amazon for less than $200, a 20% discount from the typical $250 price. The earbuds feature breakthrough audio performance with three-dimensional sound, transformed bass, and vivid vocals. They also have great noise-cancelling technology, call quality, and battery life, making them comfortable to wear. Announced in September 2025, AirPods Pro 3 have been praised for their advanced features and excellent performance. Amazon has offered various discounts on the earbuds, including a Black Friday deal and current sales. The discounted price of $199.49 is available on Amazon, beating previous pricing and offering significant savings on Apple's latest earbuds.

stories.headline: [Forbes] iOS 26.6 Release Date: Why New iPhone Software Update Is Tracking For Early July The next iPhone software update could be the last major release of the iOS 26 cycle. And it looks like it might arrive much sooner than last year’s schedule.
stories.summary: Apple's next iPhone software update, iOS 26.6, is expected to arrive in early July, ahead of the typical yearly release schedule. This update will be the last major release of the iOS 26 cycle before the launch of iOS 27 in September. iOS 26.6 developer beta 1 has been deployed, with a build number of 23G5028e, and is expected to be a minor update that fixes software bugs and security vulnerabilities. The only new feature discovered so far is a notification warning users when they're approaching the limit on blocked calls. The exact release date is unknown, but it's predicted to be this week or next week. Users can install the update once it's publicly available, with instructions to be provided at that time. The update builds on iOS 26 and subsequent releases since last fall.

stories.headline: [Kotaku] Maker Of Acclaimed 2026 Game Pass Shooter Is Already Closing The makers of Luna Abyss won't get a second shot
stories.summary: The studio behind the acclaimed 2026 Game Pass shooter Luna Abyss is closing less than a month after the game's release. Despite receiving glowing reviews and positive player ratings on Steam, the studio is preparing to shut down. Luna Abyss was released on May 21, 2026, for PC, PlayStation, and Xbox platforms, with Xbox Play Anywhere, Xbox cloud saves, and optimization for Xbox Series X|S. The game was also available on Game Pass for Xbox Series X|S and PC. The closure comes as a surprise given the game's positive reception, with reviewers praising its atmospheric solo adventure gameplay. The studio's closure will likely mean no further updates or support for the game, and no potential sequels or new projects from the developer. The exact reasons for the studio's closure have not been disclosed.

stories.headline: [Anime News Network] Persona 4 Revival Game Announces New English Voice Cast Nazeeh Tarsha, Paul Castro Jr., Anne Yatco, Brianna Knickerbocker, Ari Thrash join cast of February 18 game
stories.summary: Sega announced the English voice cast for Persona 4 Revival, a remake of the 2008 role-playing game. Nazeeh Tarsha will voice the Protagonist, while Paul Castro Jr. will play Yosuke Hanamura. Anne Yatco is cast as Chie Satonaka, and Brianna Knickerbocker will voice Yukiko Amagi. Additional cast members include Ari Thrash. The game is set to release on February 18. The original game was released in 2008, and this remake will feature a new English voice cast. The Japanese voice cast includes Daisuke Namikawa as the Protagonist. The announcement reveals the main characters' English voice actors, with more information possibly forthcoming. Persona 4 Revival is a highly anticipated game, and the new voice cast brings a fresh take to the beloved characters.

stories.headline: Czech Republic vs South Africa: Preview and Prediction Czech Republic and South Africa will both be desperate to get off the mark in the FIFA World Cup when they clash in their second fixtures.
stories.summary: The Czech Republic and South Africa are set to face off in their second FIFA World Cup fixtures, both seeking their first win. The Czech Republic is expected to edge the encounter due to their greater technical quality, despite losing to South Korea in their previous match. South Africa will aim to secure their first World Cup 2026 victory, having lost half of their last six matches. The Czech Republic will likely rely on structured superiority and Patrik Schick's finishing instincts to secure a narrow win. In response, South Africa is anticipated to defend deep and compact, similar to their strategy against Mexico. Both teams are under pressure to perform, having lost their opening games in the competition. The match is crucial for both sides, with a win essential to keep their World Cup hopes alive.

stories.headline: Former Kaizer Chiefs Colombian striker makes no secret of his support for Bafana Bafana at the 2026 FIFA World Cup – ‘South Africa holds a place in our hearts’
stories.summary: A former Kaizer Chiefs Colombian striker has expressed his support for South Africa's national football team, Bafana Bafana, at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The striker stated that South Africa holds a special place in their heart. This comes as Bafana Bafana prepares to compete in the tournament, which will be held in Canada, Mexico, and the United States. The team's coach, Hugo Broos, had previously announced his final 26-man squad for the World Cup. Recently, there have been discussions about the team's chances and the support they are receiving from various individuals. The striker's endorsement is a notable show of support for Bafana Bafana as they gear up for the international competition. Bafana Bafana's participation in the World Cup has been a topic of interest, with the team facing various challenges and controversies in the lead-up to the tournament.

stories.headline: Where does Folarin Balogun's two-goal brilliance rank? The top five USMNT World Cup performances of all time, from Claudio Reyna to Tim Howard
stories.summary: Folarin Balogun scored twice in the USMNT's 4-1 win over Paraguay in their 2026 World Cup opener. The victory marked the team's biggest win in the tournament. Balogun's two goals made him the first American player to score multiple goals in a World Cup game since 1930. The USMNT had a historic three-goal first half, with Balogun's goals contributing to the team's dominant performance. The win was the USMNT's first game in their first home World Cup in 32 years. The performance has sparked discussion about the top USMNT World Cup performances of all time, with Balogun's display being compared to those of notable players like Claudio Reyna and Tim Howard. The USMNT's strong start to the tournament has generated excitement and anticipation for their upcoming games.

stories.headline: Black Caps v England: How New Zealand begin to replace Kane Williamson
stories.summary: New Zealand has called up experienced top-order batter Will Young to replace Kane Williamson in the Test squad against England. Williamson abruptly retired from international cricket during the ongoing series, leaving a significant gap at number 3. Young is set to arrive in England and begin training with the squad ahead of the second Test at The Oval, starting on June 17. He will join the team as a direct replacement for Williamson, who announced his retirement after the first Test at Lord's. Young's addition aims to fill the void left by Williamson's departure, as New Zealand seeks to regain momentum in the series against England. The Black Caps will rely on Young's expertise to stabilize their batting lineup in the remaining two Tests.

stories.headline: Delhi Police bust Pakistan-backed terror syndicate, seven held
stories.summary: Delhi Police have busted a Pakistan-backed terror syndicate operating in the Delhi-NCR region, arresting seven operatives. The module was involved in smuggling arms and narcotics from across the border. The syndicate used social media, encrypted messaging platforms, hawala channels, and anonymous accounts for recruitment, financing, and logistics. The arrests have thwarted several planned terror incidents in Delhi-NCR. The seven accused individuals were taken into custody by the Delhi Police Special Cell. According to police, the module was sponsored by Pakistan and had planned to carry out terror strikes in the national capital. The arrests have prevented potential attacks and disrupted the terror network's operations in the region. The police action has resulted in the dismantling of the Pakistan-backed terror-crime module.

stories.headline: ₹15 crore will be paid to MPs tonight, says Shiv Sena (UBT) leader
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut has alleged that Maharashtra MPs will receive ₹15 crore each as an advance tonight. Raut expressed shock and disgust at the information, suggesting that the money is being offered to MPs to switch sides. The allegation comes amid intense political speculation in Maharashtra over a possible realignment. Raut made the claim on social media, tagging Devendra Fadnavis, and reiterated it multiple times, calling the situation "shocking and revolting." The claim has sparked concerns about the possibility of horse-trading and a larger political upheaval in the state. Raut's remarks have added to the existing uncertainty and tension within Maharashtra's political landscape, with many awaiting further developments and confirmation of the allegations. The situation is being closely watched, with potential implications for the state's political stability.

stories.headline: Indian ‘abducted by locals’ at Bangladesh border brought back to Assam
stories.summary: A 66-year-old Indian farmer, Ranjit Das, was abducted by suspected Bangladeshi nationals while collecting grass in an area beyond the border fence in Cachar district, Assam. The incident occurred in broad daylight, causing panic among villagers. Das was taken into Bangladesh, but was later handed over to Indian authorities by the Bangladesh Border Guard at around 10 pm on Tuesday. According to Cachar SSP Sanjib Kumar Saikia, the area where Das was abducted is Indian territory, but accessible to locals. The abduction has raised fresh concerns over security in the area. Das, a resident of Cachar district, was safely returned home after being assaulted. The incident has created tension along the India-Bangladesh border in Assam's Cachar district. Necessary action will be taken by Bangladeshi authorities against the abductors, who are Bangladesh nationals.

stories.headline: No foul play, says father of Vizag techie found dead near Mussoorie
stories.summary: A 27-year-old IT professional, P Radha Gayatri, from Delhi was found dead at a homestay in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand. Her body was discovered on the floor of the room, unclothed, with blood from her nose and urine nearby. The circumstances of her death are mysterious, leading to suspicions of foul play. However, her father has stated that there was no foul play involved. The police are investigating the incident, which occurred at a homestay on the Mussoorie-Dhanolti road. Radha Gayatri worked as a software engineer in Gurugram and was from Vizag. The exact cause of her death is yet to be determined, with the police still gathering evidence and conducting their inquiry.

stories.headline: US-Qatar Talks at G7 Spark a New Era in Middle East Diplomacy In a pivotal meeting at the G7 summit, President Trump and Qatar's Emir discussed the implications of a landmark US-Iran deal
stories.summary: US President Trump and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani met at the G7 summit to discuss the implications of a landmark US-Iran deal. The meeting emphasized regional security and hailed the agreement as transformative, marking a new phase in geopolitics. The leaders addressed recent military tensions involving Israel and Lebanon, and underscored the strength of bilateral relations. The US-Iran agreement and its implications for Middle East stability were also discussed. The meeting comes as the G7 summit shifts its focus towards the Middle East, with the US-Iran deal remaining somewhat secretive. The talks between Trump and the Emir are seen as a pivotal moment in Middle East diplomacy, with potential to bring about a new era of cooperation and stability in the region. The meeting is part of a series of discussions at the G7 summit.

stories.headline: Geopolitics Moved Gold For A Day Technicals Moved It For A Quarter Plus War's Summary and it's surprising impact on gold
stories.summary: Gold prices fell 10.76% over the past month, despite being 21.83% higher than a year ago. The decline was driven by a surge in oil prices, which lifted inflation and reduced the likelihood of rate cuts, instead building a case for hikes. This led to a stronger dollar and higher real yields, negatively impacting gold. The metal's price movement was initially influenced by geopolitical factors, but technicals have driven it for over a quarter. In contrast, silver has seen an explosive move due to soaring industrial demand from electronics and solar panels, with investors now jumping on board. Gold's price drop has been significant, but its year-over-year increase remains substantial, with the metal still being closely watched by investors and analysts for its potential future movements. Gold's value is updated in real-time, with forecasts and news available.

stories.headline: President Trump and Qatar's Emir discussed the implications of a landmark US-Iran deal
stories.summary: President Trump and Qatar's Emir, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, discussed the implications of a landmark US-Iran deal at the G7 summit. The agreement is seen as transformative, marking a new phase in geopolitics, and addresses recent military tensions involving Israel and Lebanon. Qatar's credibility with the Trump administration gave it leverage in Tehran, enabling it to facilitate a deal. The meeting highlighted Qatar's pivotal role as a US security partner, hosting the largest American military base in the Middle East. The two leaders emphasized regional security and hailed the agreement as a positive development. The US-Iran deal follows Qatar's mediation efforts, including support for Pakistan's diplomatic push, and the US seeking Qatar's help to convince Iran to accept a ceasefire pact with Israel. The deal underscores the strong bilateral relationship between the US and Qatar.

stories.headline: US-Iran deal implications on regional security discussed at G7 summit
stories.summary: G7 leaders discussed the US-Iran agreement at the summit in France, focusing on its implications for regional security. The deal, announced by US President Donald Trump, aims to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and pause the conflict. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated that the agreement represents an opportunity for regional stability and the global economy, and that Germany has deployed mine-clearing vessels to prepare for the Strait's reopening. Trump clarified that the agreement does not include sanctions relief for Iran. The Middle East featured prominently in discussions, with leaders reaffirming support for Ukraine and pledging tougher sanctions on Russia. The G7 leaders also stressed the importance of a free and open Indo-Pacific amid rising regional tensions, and discussed access to cutting-edge US AI models for trusted partners. The details of the US-Iran agreement remain largely unknown.

stories.headline: India’s Strongest Regional Party Collapses Thanks to Modi’s BJP
stories.summary: India's strongest regional party, the Trinamool Congress (TMC), has collapsed, with 20 of its parliamentarians aligning with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA). This shift has strengthened the Modi government, increasing its numbers. The TMC's collapse follows its wipeout in the West Bengal assembly election, where the BJP secured a sweeping victory. The INDIA alliance, a bloc of regional parties formed to counter the BJP, has also fallen apart. The BJP and its allies now hold power in 21 out of 28 provinces, solidifying the party's dominance. The Modi-led federal government has made significant gains, positioning itself strongly ahead of the 2029 Lok Sabha elections. The BJP's victory in West Bengal marks a significant milestone in its expansion across the country.

stories.headline: Legislators of the Trinamool Congress, which ruled West Bengal for three straight terms, have left the party in droves, leaving it a mere shadow of its former self
stories.summary: The Trinamool Congress, which ruled West Bengal for three straight terms, is facing a severe internal crisis as legislators leave the party in large numbers. This exodus has significantly weakened the party, leaving it a shadow of its former self. The crisis deepened with the resignation of former West Bengal Minister Manas Ranjan Bhunia. The party's decline marks a significant shift in West Bengal's political landscape, which had long resisted national political trends. The BJP's breach of this regional stronghold may signal a new phase in the Modi project. Meanwhile, the TMC has appointed a new chief whip in the Lok Sabha, Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar, whose role was approved by Speaker Om Birla. The party's internal turmoil comes as other states, such as Tamil Nadu, see changes in their political landscapes, with the DMK-Congress alliance and TVK making gains.

stories.headline: Modi's BJP gains upper hand in West Bengal as Trinamool Congress crumbles
stories.summary: The Trinamool Congress in West Bengal is facing a crisis, with the BJP gaining an upper hand. The BJP has retained its strongholds in north Bengal and southwest Bengal, and made significant inroads in Kolkata and adjoining districts, formerly Trinamool bastions. This shift comes as the Trinamool Congress, which ended three decades of Left Front rule, is now struggling to maintain its grip on the state. Despite winning recent assembly bypolls, the party is facing internal strife, with some MPs reportedly considering joining the BJP. The BJP's gains in West Bengal are a notable exception to the broader anti-incumbent trend in recent state elections, where the party lost power in Kerala to the Congress-led United Democratic Front, but retained power in Assam. The Trinamool Congress's struggles have raised questions about its future in the state.

stories.headline: Trinamool Congress collapse spells trouble for Indian opposition ahead of national elections
stories.summary: The Trinamool Congress is facing a significant internal crisis, triggered by a recent electoral defeat. Approximately 58 of the party's 80 MLAs defied leader Abhishek Banerjee by choosing their own leader of opposition in the West Bengal Assembly. Additionally, Trinamool MPs in the Lok Sabha have broken into two groups, further dividing the party. This comes as Abhishek Banerjee has been summoned by a Tripura court in an old case. The party's collapse poses trouble for the Indian opposition ahead of national elections, potentially weakening the INDIA coalition and affecting opposition prospects in upcoming state elections, particularly in Uttar Pradesh and Karnataka. The Trinamool Congress's defeat has already undermined Mamata Banerjee's status as a national opposition leader, allowing the BJP to consolidate Hindu votes in West Bengal.

stories.headline: Stock Market Today Highlights, June 16: Sensex gains 544 pts, Nifty settles at 23,989 on US-Iran peace deal
stories.summary: Benchmark stock indices Sensex and Nifty rose for the third consecutive day on Tuesday, driven by a positive global market trend and softening crude oil prices following a US-Iran peace deal. The Sensex gained 544 points to settle at 76,808, while the Nifty rose 135 points to close at 23,989. The rupee also gained 0.2% to 94.56 against the dollar. The market surge was fueled by the peace deal between the US and Iran, which led to a decline in crude oil prices. Investors are now awaiting the details of the Iran deal and the Federal Reserve's decision, with Dow futures holding steady ahead of the Fed meeting. The positive trend in global markets also contributed to the rise in Indian benchmark indices.

stories.headline: Stock markets today: Sensex, Nifty extend gains as crude oil prices drop, IT stocks surge
stories.summary: Indian stock markets extended their gains as the Sensex closed at 82,055.11, up 158.32 points, and the Nifty at 25,044.35, up 72.45 points. The rally was driven by a drop in crude oil prices to three-month lows and a surge in IT stocks, boosting investor optimism. This follows a 2% surge in the Nifty on Friday, which added approximately Rs 10 lakh crore in market capitalization, driven by easing US-Iran tensions and declining crude oil prices. The decline in oil prices and positive sentiment in the IT sector contributed to the market's upward trend. The gains in Indian markets come after US stocks moved lower earlier due to an Iran war-fueled sell-off, but the current drop in oil prices has improved investor sentiment in India.

stories.headline: Sensex Jumps 544 Points, Nifty Ends Near 24,000 As US-Iran Deal Lifts Market Sentiment
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex jumped 544 points to 74,548, with the Nifty ending near 24,000, driven by improved market sentiment following a US-Iran deal. The previous day's closing value of the BSE Sensex was 73,832.55. The index opened at 74,709.27 and reached a high of 75,608.02, representing a 2.30% increase. The surge in the Sensex was fueled by positive global cues and the easing of geopolitical tensions. The Nifty also saw significant gains, nearing the 24,000 mark. The rally was broad-based, with all sectors participating in the uptrend. The market's positive momentum is expected to continue, driven by improving investor sentiment and favorable global developments.

stories.headline: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
stories.summary: The Indian stock market ended lower on Tuesday due to widespread losses in financial and pharma stocks. Despite gains in Mahindra & Mahindra, Reliance Industries, and Bharti Airtel, the market extended Monday's declines. The S&P 500 in the US seesawed, with gains in megacap stocks like Apple offsetting losses from mixed corporate earnings. Apple rose 2.5%, supporting the Nasdaq after Monday's declines. In India, the Nifty had previously closed the week on a positive note, with a 0.4% gain or 73 points, reaching 18,200. The market's performance was influenced by global trends and the debate over the "Sell America" trade, sparked by US threats and corporate earnings. The Indian market's action on Wednesday will be decided by various factors, including global market trends and corporate earnings.

stories.headline: Pizza Hut restaurant chain will be sold for US$2.7 billion
stories.summary: Yum Brands will sell its Pizza Hut chain for $2.7 billion in two deals. The private equity firm LongRange Capital will buy Pizza Hut, excluding the mainland China business, for approximately $1.5 billion. The sale is expected to close in the third quarter. The deal comes as the fast-food industry faces stiff competition and cautious consumer spending. Yum Brands' decision to sell Pizza Hut is part of its efforts to focus on its other brands, such as KFC and Taco Bell. The sale of Pizza Hut's mainland China business is part of a separate deal, bringing the total sale price to $2.7 billion. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and is expected to be completed later this year.

stories.headline: HDFC Bank board to review findings on Atanu Chakraborty's exit on June 18
stories.summary: HDFC Bank's board will meet on June 18 to review the findings on Atanu Chakraborty's exit. Preliminary reports indicate no governance issues were found. The board will also seek a three-month extension for interim chairman Keki Mistry, subject to RBI approval. An internal review at the bank found no material governance lapses after Chakraborty's departure. Chakraborty has described his resignation as "routine". The findings are expected to steady investor confidence and pave the way for the CEO term proposal. HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan has vowed to conduct board reviews following Chakraborty's exit, which was recently cleared by the RBI. The bank's shares had fallen 11 percent following the news. The board meeting aims to address concerns and provide clarity on the matter.

stories.headline: Lockheed, GM announce partnership to bolster production for munitions and more
stories.summary: Lockheed Martin and General Motors have announced a partnership to bolster production of munitions and other defense-related products. The collaboration aims to strengthen the US manufacturing and defense industrial base. Lockheed Martin, the top US defense manufacturer, is working to triple or quadruple its production, and GM's industrial capabilities will be utilized to explore defense production opportunities. The partnership will leverage GM's manufacturing expertise to support Lockheed Martin's production goals. This collaboration comes as the country ramps up its production of weapons, with Lockheed Martin's products including the THAAD air defense interceptor. GM Defense and Lockheed Martin will work together to identify areas where GM's capabilities can support Lockheed's production needs, enhancing the US defense industrial base. The partnership is expected to contribute to the country's increased demand for defense products.

stories.headline: KFC Announces 'Next Chapter' for Its Chicken
stories.summary: KFC has announced its "next chapter" with a broad update focusing on boneless chicken and enhanced menu options. The chain is introducing more boneless chicken options, including tenders designed for dipping and snacking. This move is in response to growing competition from newer players like Popeyes and Slim Chickens. The changes will be rolled out to over 34,000 restaurants across more than 150 countries. KFC UK & Ireland is already implementing a phased rollout of its Tenders & Dips range. The company aims to unlock its next chapter of relevance and growth, with a new leadership team in place to drive this effort. The update also includes drinks with more flair, as KFC bets its future on boneless chicken and enhanced menu offerings. This strategic shift is expected to propel the brand forward in the competitive fast-food market.

stories.headline: SpaceX buys AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion in race for an edge over Anthropic and OpenAI
stories.summary: SpaceX has acquired AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion. The deal, announced in a regulatory filing, is expected to close in the third quarter, with Cursor becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX. Cursor's shareholders will receive $60 billion worth of SpaceX shares. The acquisition aims to bolster SpaceX's efforts to compete with rivals Anthropic and OpenAI, which offer popular coding tools. The deal is set to be completed by the end of September. Elon Musk's SpaceX made the announcement, marking a significant investment in AI technology. The acquisition will likely enhance SpaceX's capabilities in AI-powered coding and development, allowing it to stay competitive in the industry. The $60 billion deal is a substantial investment, underscoring the importance of AI technology in SpaceX's future plans.

stories.headline: SpaceX buys AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion
stories.summary: SpaceX is acquiring AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion in an all-stock transaction. The deal comes after SpaceX's record-breaking initial public offering, which raised $75 billion. Cursor, founded in 2022, is known for its "vibe coding" trend, where AI coding assistants can perform computer programming tasks. The acquisition is expected to bolster SpaceX's competitive edge in the AI market against rivals Anthropic and OpenAI. Elon Musk's company will use the deal to expand its presence in the enterprise AI tools market. The transaction is part of SpaceX's efforts to enhance its capabilities, having recently acquired xAI and the Colossus supercomputer. The acquisition is seen as a strategic move to solidify SpaceX's position in the rapidly evolving AI industry.

stories.headline: SpaceX buys AI startup Cursor for $60 billion
stories.summary: SpaceX has acquired AI startup Cursor in a $60 billion deal. The acquisition values the artificial intelligence coding startup at $60 billion, with Elon Musk aiming to catch up with rivals. The deal is part of SpaceX's efforts to expand its capabilities in AI software. Cursor is an AI coding startup, and the acquisition is seen as a significant move in the industry consolidation of AI software companies. The deal does not have a direct revenue impact on any public company, but rather has implications one layer down. SpaceX's acquisition of Cursor is a major development in the AI industry, with potential implications for the future of AI software companies. The $60 billion deal is one of the largest in recent history, highlighting the growing importance of AI in the tech industry.

stories.headline: How Hamza Mostafa Went from an Unpaid Internship to OpenAI's First Intern Cohort
stories.summary: Hamza Mostafa began his career with an unpaid internship at a Toronto incubator, where he was the founder's first hire. He is currently an undergraduate student in Computer Science at the University of Waterloo. Mostafa later joined OpenAI as part of its first intern cohort, where he was able to ship code on his first day. He found the environment at OpenAI to be fast-paced, allowing him to work efficiently. Through his experience, Mostafa learned that AI can make engineers faster, but it is judgment that is the real skill. He has shared his insights on his time at OpenAI, highlighting the company's rapid development pace and the importance of judgment in engineering. Mostafa's journey from an unpaid internship to working with a leading AI company like OpenAI showcases his growth and learning in the field.
